task: W200-A3: malignant-only TACSTD2 NMPR vs MPR and vs T/NK
honest_verdict: Recomputed on 92330 cells (175.5 MB processed UMI). Author per-cell labels are not public; marker-based malignant-like n=6627. NMPR>MPR malignant TACSTD2 is not supported (sample-level mean log1p median 1.624 vs 1.561, MWU p=0.89; only 2/4 MPR samples have ≥1 malignant-like cell). Sample-level TACSTD2 vs T/NK is a null: post eligible ρ=0.18, p=0.7, n=7; all eligible ρ=-0.14, p=0.7, n=10; closest |ρ| among planned tests is 0.30 (post, CP10k, n=10, p=0.40). recomputed ρ=0.18, p=0.7, n=7 does not match the user-stated ρ −0.40 to −0.50 window. A rejected 92,330-cell Spearman of TACSTD2 vs T/NK score is ρ=-0.16, also outside that window.
